families.name: Babblebrook Grey Rabbit Family
families.notes: One of the original families launched in Japan on 20 March 1985.

families.name: Wildwood Brown Rabbit Family
families.notes: Original 1985 family. A 2026 baby figure, Barkley Wildwood, was issued for the 40th anniversary.

families.name: Timbertop Brown Bear Family
families.notes: Original 1985 family.

families.name: McBurrows Mole Family
families.notes: Original 1985 family. Winner of the 2025 global family election; a 40th-anniversary adventure set followed in 2026.

families.name: Tanuki Family
families.notes: Japan-only original 1985 family. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Slydale Fox Family

families.name: Brighteyes Rabbit Family
families.notes: Early UK couple set; later reissued as a family.

families.name: Ivory Dog Family
families.notes: Japan-only early dog family.

families.name: Brown Dog Family
families.notes: Japan-only early dog family (1987). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Grey Cat Family
families.notes: Early Japan grey cats (1987), distinct from later Harvey / Fisher lines. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Ivory Cat Family
families.notes: Japan-only ivory cats (1987). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Cream Cat Family
families.notes: 1988 Japan Urban Life cream cats, distinct from the later named Keats family (2006). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Chestnut Dog Family
families.notes: Japan Urban Life dogs (item codes I-21 to I-25). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Goat Family
families.notes: Early Japan goats (1988), distinct from Nettlefield and Brightfield. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Tailbury Ocher Dog Family
families.notes: Individual named figures for this line are still being matched from catalogues; placeholder family members are not listed.

families.name: Huntington Honey Bear Family
families.notes: Also listed as Honeybear in some catalogues.

families.name: Teardrop Bear Family
families.notes: 1991 bear family. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Bramble Hedgehog Family
families.notes: A long-running hedgehog line; later Japan reissues kept the Bramble name.

families.name: Marmalade Bear Family
families.notes: Grandparents were later issued as a separate set.

families.name: Seadog Dog Family
families.notes: Captain Horatio Seadog is the best-known figure from this line.

families.name: Waddlington Duck Family
families.notes: Flair/Tomy duck family; mayor Bill Waddlington.

families.name: Cottontail Rabbit Family

families.name: Macavity Striped Cat Family
families.notes: Predecessor to the later Sandy striped cats.

families.name: Periwinkle Milk Rabbit Family
families.notes: A flagship rabbit family. Version 2 figures arrived 2022 JP / 2023 UK.

families.name: Kennelworth Dalmatian Family
families.notes: Early 2000s Dalmatians, distinct from the 2022/2025 Dalmatian line.

families.name: Calbee Bear Family
families.notes: Japan promotional Calbee bears (2004). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Pigglywink Pig Family
families.notes: Calico Critters exclusive (US, 2004). Same pig mould as later Grunt family, with chenille tails.

families.name: Dale Sheep Family
families.notes: Version 2 figures arrived 2021 JP / 2022 UK.

families.name: Ermine Family
families.notes: Japan Forest Market exclusive (2006); shares the Vandyke otter mould. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Wildflower Nonohana Rabbit Family
families.notes: Japan Nonohana (wildflower) rabbits. Individual named figures for this line are still being matched from catalogues; placeholder family members are not listed.

families.notes: The largest and most-issued rabbit family. Freya is a long-running mascot. Version 2 in 2022; 40th-anniversary editions in 2025.

families.name: Persis Persian Cat Family
families.notes: First of several Persian lines; later Teak and Persian families followed.

families.name: Breeze Cat Family
families.notes: Japan Grinpa Park exclusive (2009). Only the sister and baby were sold; the full family is a park display.

families.name: Springgarden Rabbit Family
families.notes: Japan-only.

families.name: Momoiro Rabbit Family
families.notes: Japan Collectors Club peach-pink rabbits (2009). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Lavender Rabbit Family
families.notes: Japan-only.

families.name: Spotter Meerkat Family
families.notes: Reissued in Japan in 2021.

families.name: Buttercup Friesian Cow Family
families.notes: Reissued in Japan in 2021.

families.notes: Japan kangaroo line; later international Easy Buy sets used the Hopper name.

families.notes: Reissued with new outfits in 2025.

families.notes: Japan hedgehog family alongside the long-running Bramble line.

families.name: Grand Lion Family
families.notes: Town concert and seasonal sets only — Epoch never issued a four-figure Grand Lion family box.

families.notes: Shiba Inu family; Japan 2021, UK/EU/US 2022. Official shop exclusive.

families.name: Beaver Family (Japan 2021)
families.notes: Japan beaver issue alongside Woodbrook. No separately named figures confirmed — not listing copies of the Woodbrook family.

families.name: Dalmatian Family
families.notes: UK family 2022; Japan 2024 (including older brother John). A 40th-anniversary Dalmatian family followed in 2025.

families.name: Citrus Bird Family
families.notes: Family set is mother with three babies; father is bundled with the Citrus Bird juice shop.

families.name: Flyer Flying Squirrel Family
families.notes: Japan 2026 flying squirrels, issued as a parents-and-baby set (FS-64) and a siblings set. Five confirmed members.

families.name: Pomeranian Family
families.notes: 2026 Pomeranian line (sets 5876 family trio, 5877 twins). Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Jones Corgi Family
families.notes: New corgi family announced early 2026.

families.name: Tigrus Tiger Family
families.notes: Japan 2026 tiger family. Spike is a known cub figure.

families.name: Fox Family
families.notes: 2026 fox line, distinct from the 1995 Renard foxes. Public catalogues list these figures by role only — given names were not published, so unnamed placeholders are not listed.

families.name: Pony Friends
families.notes: Standalone pony girl figures rather than a family of four.
